finding.text: The status line on screen still shows only mic · socket · whisper. The session and assistants words go to the console only, and `doc/status-signals.md` admits the on-screen line is "the remaining, named gap" (req 1) — shots/…-Dictate/1200.png, the line under the composer.
The socket says "retrying" with no count. The brief asked for "retrying n" on close — `Dictate.js:300` returns a bare `"retrying"` (req 1).

The two new classes break the folder = file = class rule the brief named: `class Floor` lives in lowercase `floor.js`, and `class ChatController` sits inside `chat.js` (req 2; CLAUDE.md "a lowercase file never holds a class").
The Live tab is not nested. It shows three flat groups (Dictate, Floor, Chat sessions) side by side, not "Dictate → its parts" as icon items in a hierarchy (req 3) — `live/page.js` `redraw()`.

The proof is missing. task.jsonl has no `[dictate]` console trail and no reload result, and no shot reaches the running instances: every Live shot ends on the class cards (req 4). The merge has not happened yet either (req 5).
The Live page logs a 404 at all four widths — `layout.json` errors[]; probably a missing resource such as `readme.md` for `md.details`.
The Floor class card shows no icon, and its title is centred, unlike Dictate's. `podium` is probably not a valid icon name — shots/…-live/1200.png, second card.
The page's first screen is about classes; the live instances, which are the point of the page, start below 1.5 screens (band `ux-dictate-live` at y 1579 at 1200).

The live tree throws away what the reader opened, once a second (requirement 3; navigation 6). `redraw()` empties `$live` and rebuilds every instance row with `open: false`. If the owner opens a mic to read its properties, the next tick closes it again, so the instance properties the owner asked to see can't actually be read. Keep each row's open state across ticks, or update the values in place.

The review shots don't show the page in this diff (requirement 4). In the diff, `live/page.js` puts the intro and the live tree first, then a `### The three classes, API first` heading, then the class cards. In `shots/…-Dictate-live/1920.png` and in layout.json's bands (`ux-dictate-live-classes` above `ux-dictate-live` at every width), the class cards come first, under a bold run-in sentence, and there is no intro. The only picture of the tree is the extra `shots/live-tree-1920.png`. Take the shots again from the merged code.

`doc/status-signals.md` contradicts the code (requirement 1; words 7). The doc says only mic, socket and whisper draw on screen, and calls the session and assistants words "the remaining, named gap". But the `$diag` line now prints all five stages, and `shots/overview-status-line-1920.png` shows `session: started · assistants: replied`. The table is the doc the owner asked for, so it has to describe what the screen really shows.

The Live page is one narrow column on a nearly empty screen (layout 1, 7). layout.json reports `empty` 0.84 at 3440. The `ux-dictate-live` band has `big_empty: true` at 1200, 1920 and 3440 (ink 0.068 at 3440), and the class cards also have `big_empty: true` at 3440. At 1920 and 3440 the three class cards stack in one 480px column (`1920.png`). Put the tree and the class cards side by side, or let the cards fill the row.

Every mic row is labelled just "idle" (`shots/live-tree-1920.png`: "mics (6)", then six rows reading "idle"). The reader can't tell which mic is which surface (page 8). Name each mic by where it is mounted, with its state after the name.

`Floor.js` and `ChatController.js` sit loose in `ux/Dictate/`, not in their own `Floor/Floor.js` and `ChatController/ChatController.js` folders (requirement 2 says "folder = file = class name"; this is also the CLAUDE.md trap). Separately, the deleted `floor.js` and the new `Floor.js` differ only in capitalisation. On Windows (a case-insensitive filesystem) a checkout can get that rename wrong, so check it once after the merge.

On the class card, Floor has no icon and its title is centred, while Dictate's card has an icon and a left-aligned title (`shots/…-Dictate-live/1920.png`, bottom band). Give Floor (and ChatController) a `static icon`.

The status-signals table (requirement 1's own deliverable) still says the socket shows `retrying`, but the code now shows `retrying N` (`Dictate.js` `socket_status()`); the "Reading the trail" block also prints `socket: retrying`. Update both rows so the table matches the words on screen — doc/status-signals.md, socket row.

At 3440 the live tree is a big, nearly empty band (layout 7): layout.json `ux-dictate-live` share 0.52, ink 0.125, `big_empty: true`, and the three class cards sit below it, off the first screen at every width. Put the class cards beside the tree once there is room (a `wide flex auto` row holding both) instead of stacking them under it — shots/…-Dictate-live/3440.png.

live/readme.md's Watch out says "a nested card you had open closes again on the next tick", but live/page.js now keeps open rows open across redraws (`open_keys` + `data-key`). The readme contradicts the code; drop that line.

The six mic rows read `#1 idle … #6 idle` with nothing saying which surface each one belongs to (the ✦ sheet, the drawer, this page's demo), so a reader can't tell them apart (page 8) — shots/…-Dictate-live/1920.png, tree band. One label per mount (its surface or path) would fix it.

The rename from `floor.js` to `Floor.js` leaves old lowercase references outside the diff: `ext/Chat/doc/floor.md:59` links to `/framework/ux/Dictate/floor.js`, which will 404 on a case-sensitive static host. Old comments also remain in `ext/Chat/doc/floor.md`, `ext/Session/doc/markers.md`, `ext/Session/doc/sessions.md`, `ux/Dictate/doc/widget.md`, `Servex/agents/Assistant.js:128` and `Sessions.js:205`. Separately, `Dictate/files.jsonl` lists both `floor.js` and `Floor.js`, with no `gone` line for the lowercase one.
The class-card row sets `--gap: 1em` inline, which is a constant gap and not the spacing clamp (spacing 37) — live/page.js `.style({ "--column": "22em", "--gap": "1em" })`. Use the default `gap`.

The tree puts `Floor` and the chat sessions under a "Dictate" root, but they are not parts of any one Dictate instance; the root is really "the Dictate system". This is fine as a grouping, but the root's label could say so.

The review shots of the Live page do not show the code in the diff (page 7, layout 1–3) — `shots/…Dictate-live/1920.png` has the root row "Dictate" and the class cards stacked below the tree; the diff names the root "The Dictate system" and puts the classes beside it in a `wide flex` row. layout.json agrees with the old code: at 1200, `ux-dictate-live` y 341 and `ux-dictate-live-classes` y 1011 (stacked), with a separate `md` band between them. Only the builder's own `live-tree-1920.png` shows the new layout. Shoot it again from the worktree before merging; the layout answers below are judged on stale pixels.

Adding the Live tab pushed DOCS onto a second tab row at 1200 (navigation 4, wrapping 21) — `tab_rows 1` at 1920 but `2` at 1200 on both pages; `shots/…Dictate/1200.png`, top band. Group or shorten the tabs (Live could sit under Docs or Overview) so the bar stays on one row at 1200.

The Live tree shows no real running state (requirement 4, "screenshot of the Live tab with real states") — every row is `#1 idle … #6 idle`, `floor: idle`, `chat sessions: none yet` (`live-tree-1920.png`, `…Dictate-live/400.png`). Six identical mics can't be told apart; the readme admits this. One shot taken while the mic is listening or a session has started would prove the tree is live.

The status table and the code disagree about "assistants: answering" — `doc/status-signals.md` says it is earned by "`draw()` first drew an assistant line … or a `stream()` token", but in `chat.js` only the first stream token sets it, and `draw()` sets "replied". Fix the doc row.
`live/readme.md` still says the class cards sit "Below the tree", but `live/page.js` now puts them beside it.

`ChatController.js`'s comment claims `Capture.js` follows the folder = file = class rule, but the file is still lowercase `capture.js`, which breaks that rule (CLAUDE.md traps). It is outside this task's scope, but the comment is wrong.

The case-only rename `floor.js` → `Floor.js` updates every caller in the diff (rail.js, tabs/ai.js, Session.js, chat.js, Dictate.js). But `ux/Dictate/files.jsonl` ends with `floor.js` gone and then `floor.js` added back, a sign that Windows' case-insensitive filesystem saw the old name again. Before merging, check that git records only `Floor.js`. A static host is case-sensitive, so a leftover lowercase import there would fail to load (a 404).
At 400 the five-stage status line wraps to two lines (`shots/…Dictate/400.png`, under the mic). It still reads cleanly, so this is acceptable.

At 400 the Live page keeps the tree and the class column side by side, and the class column is cut off at the right edge ("THE THREE C…", "Dict…"). The `wide flex gap` row in `live/page.js` never wraps (wrapping 1, sizing). Evidence: shots/…-Dictate-live/400.png, from y≈500 down. `overflow_x false` only because the overflow is clipped, not because the column fits.

Adding the LIVE tab pushes DOCS onto a second tab row at 1200 (navigation: tabs fit one row). Evidence: layout.json tab_rows 2 at 1200 (and at 400) on both pages; shots/…-Dictate-live/1200.png, top band.

Ask 3 says each instance row shows "its key properties and current state". Each row shows only its state word (`#1 idle`, `none yet`). The properties sit behind a closed ▸, so the default view never shows an instance's properties. Evidence: shots/…-Dictate-live/1920.png, tree band. Opening the floor row by default would show at least one real instance.

At 3440 there is a wide empty gap between the tree and the class column, and the class column starts lower than the tree. Evidence: layout.json `wide` band big_empty at 3440, empty 0.779; shots/…-Dictate-live/3440.png. Only the Dictate class card is above the fold at any width; Floor and ChatController sit below it.
The six mic rows read `#1 idle … #6 idle`, and nothing says which surface each one belongs to. The task readme names this gap honestly; it is still the first thing a reader can't tell apart.

whisper `answering` is earned by a successful health check (doc/status-signals.md). That is a real reply, but it is not a transcription. The owner's example ("only after a real reply") could be read as a transcription. The doc should say in one line which of the two it means.
`ux/Dictate/files.jsonl` ends with `floor.js` gone, then `floor.js` added again. The file list will show a `floor.js` that no longer exists, so the last line should be `Floor.js`.

Adding the Live tab pushes Dictate's tab bar to two rows at 1200: DOCS sits alone on a second line, on the Live page and on the Overview page (navigation, tabs fit one row). Evidence: layout.json tab_rows 2 at 1200 for both pages, shots/…-Dictate-live/1200.png top band. Fix it with a shorter label set, or by letting the title shrink so all seven tabs fit on one row.

At 3440 the classes column drifts to the far right. That leaves a gap of about 600px between the live tree and the class cards, and the classes heading starts below the tree's first row (layout: columns sit together). Evidence: shots/…-Dictate-live/3440.png middle band, empty 0.781. Give the row a max width, or use `flex: 0 1` bases so the two columns stay side by side.

On the class card, `state`, `engine`, `settled`, `partial_text` and `steps` print as names with no value, while the card's own text says it shows "the properties a fresh instance starts with" (content: the words match the picture). Evidence: shots/…-Dictate-live/1200.png, the right-hand Dictate card. Show `= undefined`, or show the value `render()` sets.

"mics (6)" on a page with no visible mic lists six rows (`#1 idle` … `#6 idle`), and nothing says which surface each one belongs to, so a reader can't map a row to anything on screen (content: names that can't be misread). Evidence: shots/…-Dictate-live/1920.png, tree band.

Want 2 is only partly met. `Floor` and `ChatController` became classes, but the socket, Whisper and engine checks are still functions inside `Dictate.js`, and the diff names no reason for leaving them. `ext/Session/doc/markers.md:20` still says `floor.js` after the rename to `Floor.js`.
Want 4's console trail ("[dictate]" order) is claimed in task.jsonl. This review cannot see it: no reload-then-shoot pair or console capture is in shots/.

At 3440 the Live page's two columns drift apart: the tree sits left, the class cards start about 600px to its right, and the classes intro runs one line 1189px wide (layout: columns sit together; sizing: measure). Evidence: layout.json 3440 `wide` band big_empty true, widest_text 1189; shots/…-Dictate-live/3440.png middle band. Round 5 named this as a note and it is still there. Cap the row's width, or give the columns `0 1` flex bases so they stay together and each keeps its measure.

The proof skips the reload the brief asked for (req 4: "headless load → reload"). task.jsonl line 12 records one load, a typed Send, and the trail. No reload result is logged, and a reload is the case where a saved session comes back.

On a reload the status line can contradict itself. A session restored from sessionStorage leaves `session: none` (nothing logs it), while redrawing the old thread logs `assistants: replied` for every past reply. The next Send then says `session: started` for a session that was only restored (chat.js `deliver`, `draw`). That is the "optimistic word" req 1 forbids, in a quieter form.

doc/status-signals.md's `assistants: answering` row says `draw()` can earn the word. The code logs it only on the first stream token. The `whisper: answering` row means "the health check returned ok", which is weaker than the brief's example ("only after a real reply"). The doc says so honestly, but the word is the same one the owner misread.
At 400 the intro says "Beside it: the three classes", but there the classes sit below the tree (shots/…-Dictate-live/400.png). live/readme.md says "Below the tree". The two disagree.

ux/Dictate/files.jsonl ends with `{"file":"floor.js"}` after the file was deleted. The case-only rename flapped four times, so the ledger now lists a file that does not exist. ai/files.jsonl marks chat.jsonl gone without saying why.

Tabs still wrap to 2 rows at 400 on all three pages (layout.json tab_rows 2 at 400). That is one row at 1200 and up, so the "Modes" rename fixed 1200. live/readme.md's Watch-out still says DOCS wraps at 1200, which is now stale.

The socket word is still not earned (req 1, the owner's own complaint). `socket_status()` is read once, inside `detect_engine()` (on load and on each mic press), and nothing listens to the socket's own `open`/`close` — so if the socket drops after that, the status line keeps saying "socket: connected" until the next press. The brief says "connected only on open, retrying n on close". Fix: have `Dictate` redraw `steps.socket` from `Socket`'s own open and reconnect events. Evidence: diff `Dictate.js` `socket_status()`; `detect_engine()` is its only caller (Dictate.js:319); Socket.js:89/94/118 already have the events to hook.

"whisper: answering" has the same staleness. A health check earns it once, and it stays on screen until a later segment fails or the mic is pressed again. `doc/status-signals.md` says this honestly ("the SERVER answered"), but the owner's example was "answering only after a real reply".

The doc table says "assistants: answering" comes from `draw()` "or a `stream()` token". The code sets it only on the first stream token (`chat.js` stream handler), so the doc claims more than the code does.

The Live tree's six mic rows read "#1 idle … #6 idle", plus "#2 idle · open". A reader can't tell which surface each mic belongs to, and "open" (the open-mic mode) is an undefined word (content). The readme names this gap as left open.

With seven tabs, the tab bar wraps to 2 rows at 400 on all three pages (layout.json tab_rows 2 at 400). It is one row at 1200 and wider. The readme records this as a known trade-off that belongs to `ext/tabs`.

Work outside the fence: `ext/Chat/Mic.js` gets a duplicate-bubble fix that is not one of the five asks (the brief froze everything else). `files.jsonl` picked up churn: floor.js is marked gone and re-added three times, and `ai/files.jsonl` marks chat.jsonl gone.

The class cards are below the fold at every width I was given, so the shots don't show that each one lists its methods. `inspect()` lists them by default (Inspect.js), and only properties are visible in the shots.

The socket word is still not earned (req 1, the owner's own complaint). `socket_status()` has exactly one caller: `detect_engine()` (worktree Dictate.js:334), which runs on page load and on each mic press. Nothing listens to the socket's own open and close events. So if the socket drops after the page loads, the status line keeps saying "socket: connected" until the next press. The brief asks for "connected" only on open and "retrying n" on close. Fix: redraw `steps.socket` from `Socket`'s open and reconnect events. The doc's line "read live, never cached" is also untrue as long as this is so.

"whisper: answering" goes stale the same way. One health check earns it, and it stays on screen until a segment fails or the mic is pressed again. `doc/status-signals.md` says so honestly ("the SERVER answered"), but the owner's example was "answering only after a real reply".

The doc table says "assistants: answering" comes from `draw()` "or a `stream()` token". In the code, only the first stream token sets it; `draw()` sets "replied". The doc claims more than the code does.

The Live tree's mic rows read "#1 idle … #6 idle" and "#2 idle · open" (shots/live-tree-1920.png). A reader can't tell which surface each mic belongs to, and "open" is never explained (content). The live readme names this as a gap left open.

With seven tabs, the tab bar wraps to 2 rows at 400 on all three pages (layout.json tab_rows 2 at 400; 1 row at 1200, 1920 and 3440). The readme records this as a trade-off that belongs to `ext/tabs`.

Some work is outside the fence. `ext/Chat/Mic.js` gets a duplicate-bubble fix that is not one of the five asks, and the brief froze everything else. `files.jsonl` churn: `floor.js` is marked gone and re-added three times, and `ai/files.jsonl` marks `chat.jsonl` gone.
The class cards' method lists sit below the fold at every width I was given, so no shot shows that each class lists its methods. Only the property headings are visible.

The six mic rows read "#1 idle … #6 idle" with no word for which surface each is on (the ✦ sheet, the drawer, the demo), so a newcomer can't tell them apart (requirement 3, words 2). shots/…Dictate-live/1920.png, tree band. live/readme.md names this as an open gap.

No shot reaches far enough down the Live tab to show the class cards' METHODS list. "The class view lists its methods" (requirement 3) is claimed by `inspect(Klass)` but not proven by a picture. The 1920 shot cuts off inside the Dictate card's PROPERTIES list.

On the Overview tab, `whisper: answering` is earned by the health check (`/` returned ok), not by a real transcription. The owner's example asked for "answering only after a real reply". doc/status-signals.md states this choice plainly; the alternative is a word like "reachable" until the first `/inference` succeeds.

floor.js → Floor.js changes only the letter case, and this checkout is Windows (case-insensitive). Confirm after the merge that `git ls-files` lists `Floor.js` and not `floor.js`, or every import breaks on the static host, which is case-sensitive. Comments in Servex/agents/Assistant.js:128 and Sessions.js:205 still name `floor.js`.
At 400 the seven tabs wrap to two rows (layout.json tab_rows 2 at 400, on all three pages). live/readme.md records this as an ext/tabs trade-off.
At 3440 the Live page uses a narrow strip and leaves 79% of the screen empty (sheet.png, 3440). The two columns sit together as intended, but the tree could take more of the width.
